text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be the tail oil? I just 
finished grooming my tail a moment ago... 
Is the scent too strong?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No, just thinking... you smell nice. 
...It suits you well."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, thank you. I'm glad you feel that 
way. It's the same one my mother uses, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Want to try some if you like it? 
I've got plenty in the dorm, so I can 
share.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is that... really all right? For someone 
like me to have something matching the two 
of you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. It's not custom-made or 
anything—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dura. All the more so because it is you. 
You are my junior discipline sister... and 
my proud junior.
